config.kuvalich.shieldCapMultiplier.tool:
Shield capacity multiplier based on max health
§70.5§r = 0.5x multiplier (default)
Formula: Shield Cap = Max Health × Shield Attribute × This Multiplier
§7Example:§r When shield attribute=1.0, multiplier=0.5
Shield cap is 50%% of max health
§7Example:§r When shield attribute=2.0, multiplier=0.5
Shield cap is 100%% of max health

config.kuvalich.enableTrueDamage.tooltip:
Enable true damage system (bypass setHealth and damage reduction)
§7true§r = Enabled (default)
§7false§r = Use standard setHealth method
When enabled, will find and cache the real health field of entities
This bypasses custom health systems like Apollyon
When disabled, uses standard setHealth method

kuvalich.guidebook.title: Kuva Lich Adventure Guide
kuvalich.guidebook.subtitle: Weapon Progression & Boss Challenge
kuvalich.guidebook.landing: Welcome to the $(l)§5Kuva Lich$() Adventure Guide!$(br2)This mod adds weapon progression and Boss challenges.$(br)No Warframe knowledge needed — we'll teach you from scratch.$(br2)Recommended to read chapters in order.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.overview.title: What does this mod do?
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.overview.p1: $(l)Kuva Lich$() adds weapon progression$(br)and Boss challenge systems to Minecraft.$(br2)Core gameplay loop:$(br2)Mine for materials$(br)→ Kill mobs for decryption progress$(br)→ Unlock answers, challenge the Boss$(br)→ Get weapons, install mods, get stronger$(br)→ Repeat the cycle, ever more powerful
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.overview.p2: Six major systems:$(br2)$(l)Requiem System$() — Decrypt & hunt Liches$(br2)$(l)Weapon System$() — Various Kuva weapons$(br2)$(l)Module System$() — Slot mods into gear$(br2)$(l)Element System$() — 14 elemental damage types$(br2)$(l)Shield System$() — Warframe mods grant shields$(br2)$(l)Kill Stacks$() — Kill streaks = temporary buffs
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.first_steps.p1: $(l)1. Mine$()$(br2)Mine $(l)Requiem Ore$() deep underground.$(br)Requires a diamond pickaxe.$(br2)Can yield Requiem Cards, Requiem Gems, and mods.$(br2)Use a $(thing)Requiem Destroyed$() enchanted pick —$(br)Requiem Card drop rate is greatly improved.$(br2)Regular Fortune actually reduces the drop rate.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.first_steps.p2: $(l)2. Hunt Mobs$()$(br2)Kill naturally-spawning $(l)Kuva Thralls$()$(br)to gain decryption progress.$(br2)$(l)3. Unlock Answers$()$(br2)Progress has three stages,$(br)each unlocking 1 Requiem Card answer.$(br2)Unlock all three to challenge the Boss.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.first_steps.p3: $(l)4. Challenge the Boss$()$(br2)Place 3 Requiem Cards in the $(thing)Requiem Gate$(),$(br)then kill the Kuva Lich in the correct order.$(br2)Success rewards:$(br2)Kuva weapons, high-tier mods,$(br)lots of materials, and confiscated items returned.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.first_steps.p4: $(l)5. Upgrade Gear$()$(br2)$(thing)Weapon Arsenal$()$(br)→ Install weapon mods$(br2)$(thing)Warframe Arsenal$()$(br)→ Install warframe mods$(br2)$(thing)Requiem Forge$()$(br)→ Upgrade and fuse Kuva weapons
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.first_steps.p5: Each decryption also raises weapon level caps!$(br2)This means each cycle$(br)yields stronger weapons.$(br2)Keep early low-level weapons —$(br)they make great fusion material later.
$(l)Physical Elements$()$(br2)Impact — Knocks enemies back$(br2)Puncture — Reduces target's attack$(br2)Slash — Bleed DOT that bypasses armor
$(l)Base Elements$()$(br2)Heat — Burn DOT + ignition$(br2)Cold — Slows, stackable$(br2)Electricity — AoE instant damage + stun$(br2)Toxin — DOT that bypasses armor

$(l)Combined Elements$()$(br)Two base elements auto-combine:$(br2)Heat+Cold = $(l)Blast$() — AoE damage$(br)Heat+Elec = $(l)Radiation$() — Enemies attack each other$(br)Heat+Toxin = $(l)Gas$() — AoE toxic cloud DOT$(br)Cold+Elec = $(l)Magnetic$() — Shield reduction$(br)Cold+Toxin = $(l)Viral$() — Reduces max health$(br)Elec+Toxin = $(l)Corrosive$() — Heavy armor strip

$(l)Trigger Mechanic$()$(br2)Your weapon's $(l)Status Chance$() determines$(br)the probability of triggering elemental effects.$(br2)Above 100%%, each attack$(br)can trigger multiple status procs!$(br2)The element triggered is randomly$(br)weighted by each element's damage share.

$(l)Common Builds$()$(br2)High armor enemies → Corrosive or Slash$(br2)Crowd clearing → Blast or Electricity$(br2)Sustained pressure → Viral + Slash$(br2)Crowd control → Cold$(br2)Mind element combo order when modding.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.requiem_cards.p: There are 8 Requiem Cards:$(br2)KHRA  JAHU  FASS  LOHK$(br)NETRA  VOME  XATA  RIS$(br2)Each has limited durability —$(br)consumed once per decryption attempt.$(br2)Unused cards are returned.$(br)Cards are only consumed on verification,$(br)not when placed in the Requiem Gate.

$(l)How to Obtain$()$(br2)Mine $(l)Requiem Ore$() for a chance to drop.$(br)$(thing)Requiem Destroyed$() enchanted picks greatly increase the rate.$(br2)At the $(thing)Requiem Recast$(),$(br)combine 3 any cards into 1 random new card.

$(l)Decryption Mechanic$()$(br2)Each Lich has 3 specific Requiem Cards.$(br)You need to find the right 3$(br)and arrange them in the $(l)correct order$().$(br2)The displayed answers only tell you which 3,$(br)$(l)not the correct order$()!$(br2)3 cards = 6 possible arrangements,$(br)worst case 5 attempts to succeed.$(br2)Each failure hints which position was correct.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.decryption.p1: $(l)Gaining Decryption Progress$()$(br2)Killing $(l)Kuva Thralls$() gives small progress.$(br)Killing the $(l)Kuva Lich$() gives multiplied progress.$(br2)Progress has three stages with increasing thresholds.$(br)Each stage unlocks 1 answer.$(br2)All three unlocked = ready to challenge the Boss.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.decryption.p2: $(l)Decryption Success Rewards$()$(br2)· Random Kuva weapon x1$(br)· High-tier mod (Prime or Riven)$(br)· Lots of Kuva and Riven Slivers$(br)· Lich Reliquary x1$(br)· Chance for Requiem Ultimatum$(br)· All confiscated items returned$(br)· Weapon level caps increased
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.decryption.p3: $(l)Weapon Level Caps$()$(br2)Weapon levels are randomly generated within a range.$(br)Initially the range is narrow and low.$(br2)Each successful decryption raises both caps,$(br)up to the system's absolute maximum.$(br2)Keep early low-level weapons as fusion material.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.decryption.p4: $(l)Decryption Failure Penalties$()$(br2)· Hints which position was correct$(br)  (valuable information!)$(br2)· Lich gains a level$(br)· Your damage to Lich is reduced$(br)· Lich's damage to you is increased$(br2)Penalties stack — prepare well before attempting.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.decryption.p5: $(l)Combat Boost$()$(br2)During combat with the Lich,$(br)your damage grows over time.$(br)Encourages aggressive offense over stalling.$(br2)$(l)Useful Items$()$(br2)$(thing)Requiem Riddle$()$(br)→ View unlocked answers$(br2)$(thing)Requiem Ultimatum$()$(br)→ Instantly summon a Lich
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.confiscation.p1: After unlocking any Requiem Card answer,$(br)picking up items from the ground$(br)has a chance of being confiscated by the Lich.$(br2)Confiscated items disappear$(br)with a taunting message from the Lich.$(br2)Items already in your inventory are safe —$(br)only items being picked up can trigger this.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.confiscation.p2: Each decryption cycle has a confiscation limit.$(br)Once reached, no more items are taken.$(br2)$(l)How to Get Them Back?$()$(br2)Successfully decrypt and kill the Lich,$(br)and all confiscated items$(br)drop at the kill location.$(br2)Not a single one is lost.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.confiscation.p3: $(l)Strategies$()$(br2)· Complete decryption quickly after unlocking answers$(br)  to minimize the confiscation window.$(br2)· Don't leave valuables on the ground.$(br2)· Lost a lot of items?$(br)  More motivation to defeat the Lich!
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.requiem_gate.p1: Right-click to open, place 3 Requiem Cards.$(br)Kill the Lich to auto-verify after closing.$(br2)Card durability is only consumed on verification,$(br)not on insertion or removal.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.requiem_gate.p2: $(l)Tips$()$(br2)· When the first position is confirmed correct,$(br)  lock it and only swap the other two.$(br2)· Use $(thing)Requiem Riddle$() to view answers directly.$(br2)· Each failure makes the Lich stronger —$(br)  bring food and gear.
$(l)Function 1: Card Crafting$()$(br2)3 any Requiem Cards$(br)→ Craft 1 random new card$(br2)$(l)Function 2: Mod Crafting$()$(br2)3 same-tier weapon mods$(br)→ Craft 1 random mod of that tier
Mod crafting supports:$(br)Bronze, Silver, Gold, Prime$(br2)Riven mods cannot be crafted.$(br)All three mods must be the same tier.$(br2)Result is unveiled — right-click to reveal.
The most important block with 5 functions.$(br2)Left slot = item, center = material, right = result.

$(l)Function 1: Weapon Fusion$()$(br2)Fuse two Kuva weapons into one.$(br)Takes the higher level and increases it.$(br)Inherits the material weapon's element.$(br2)$(l)Function 2: Gilding$()$(br2)Item + Riven Sliver$(br)→ Gain random base stats (crit chance, etc.)$(br2)Must gild before installing mods!

$(l)Function 3: Forma Re-roll$()$(br2)Gilded non-Kuva weapon + Forma$(br)→ Base stats re-randomized$(br2)$(l)Function 4/5: Riven Cycling$()$(br2)Riven Mod + Kuva$(br)→ Completely re-roll attributes$(br2)Kuva cost increases with each cycle.

$(l)Priority Suggestions$()$(br2)① Gild your main weapon first$(br2)② Fuse low-level weapons to increase level$(br2)③ Cycle Rivens with Kuva for good rolls$(br2)④ Use Forma if unsatisfied with base stats

$(l)Tips$()$(br2)Gilding is the entry point$(br)for any item into the mod system.$(br2)First few Riven cycles are cheap,$(br)later ones get expensive.$(br2)Place the Requiem Forge somewhere convenient!
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_weapons.p1: Ultimate weapons obtained from successful decryption.$(br2)Each has a unique passive effect.$(br)Each weapon includes:$(br2)· Fixed attributes (attack, speed, movement)$(br)· Random level (higher = stronger)$(br)· Random element (one type attached)$(br)· Base stats (crit, status, etc.)$(br2)Kuva weapons are indestructible.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_weapons.p2: $(l)Heavy$() — High damage, slow, reduces movement$(br)Best for burst damage$(br2)$(l)Light$() — Low damage, fast, increases movement$(br)Best for sustained combat$(br2)Don't just look at stat numbers —$(br)passive effects are what matter most.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_weapons.p3: $(l)Progression Tips$()$(br2)Keep early low-level weapons$(br)from your first decryptions as fusion material.$(br2)Once your level caps are high,$(br)then carefully choose your main weapon.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.weapon_panel.p1: After gilding, weapons have 4 panel stats:$(br2)$(l)Base Damage$() — Overall damage multiplier$(br2)$(l)Critical Chance$() — Probability to crit$(br2)$(l)Critical Multiplier$() — Damage multiplier on crit$(br2)$(l)Status Chance$() — Probability to trigger elements$(br2)Panel stats are randomized on gilding.$(br)Use $(thing)Forma$() to re-randomize.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.weapon_panel.p2: $(l)Crit Tiers$()$(br2)When crit chance exceeds 100%%,$(br)higher crit tiers are possible:$(br2)Normal Crit — Damage × Multiplier$(br2)Orange Crit — Damage × Multiplier × 2$(br2)Red Crit — Damage × Multiplier × 3
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.weapon_panel.p3: $(l)Damage Number Colors$()$(br2)$(#FFFFFF)White$() = Normal damage$(br2)$(#FFAA00)Orange$() = Critical hit$(br2)$(#FF5555)Red$() = Double crit$(br2)$(#AA00AA)Purple$() = Triple crit$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Cyan$() = Target has shield
$(l)Method 1: Install Mods$()$(br2)Up to 8 in the Weapon Arsenal.$(br)The primary way to strengthen weapons.$(br2)$(l)Method 2: Weapon Fusion$()$(br2)Fuse two weapons in the Requiem Forge.$(br)Takes higher level and increases it.

$(l)Method 3: Raise Level Caps$()$(br2)Each successful Lich decryption$(br)raises both min and max weapon levels.$(br2)Don't discard early low-level weapons —$(br)they're best used as fusion material.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.forma.title: Reset Weapon Panel
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.forma.p1: Gilded non-Kuva weapon + Forma$(br)→ Base stats re-randomized$(br2)Consumes 1 per use. Results are random.$(br)Only for non-Kuva weapons.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.weapon_list.int: $(l)Heavy$() — High damage, slow, reduces movement$(br)$(l)Light$() — Low damage, fast, increases movement$(br2)Choose based on passive effects and mods.

Attacks deal$(br)max HP percentage DOT$(br2)$(#AAAAAA)Light — Fastest attack speed$()
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.module_overview: Mods are the core upgrade system.$(br2)$(l)Weapon Mods$()$(br)Add damage, crit, speed, elements, etc.$(br)Install in Weapon Arsenal, up to 8.$(br2)$(l)Warframe Mods$()$(br)Add health, armor, shields, resistances, etc.$(br)Install in Warframe Arsenal, up to 8.$(br)Active at all times, no weapon needed.

$(l)Installation Rules$()$(br2)· Same mod type cannot be duplicated$(br)· Only 1 Riven allowed$(br)· Unveiled mods must be right-clicked first$(br2)$(l)How to Obtain$()$(br2)· Mine Requiem Ore (Bronze/Silver/Gold)$(br)· Kill Kuva Thralls (same)$(br)· Kill Kuva Lich (Prime/Riven)$(br)· Craft at Requiem Recast

$(l)Starter Recommendations$()$(br2)$(thing)Pressure Point$() series — Melee damage base$(br2)$(thing)Serration$() — Ranged damage$(br2)$(thing)Split Chamber$() — Multishot$(br2)$(thing)Vital Sense$() — Ranged crit damage$(br2)$(thing)True Steel$() — Melee crit
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.module_rarity.p: From weakest to strongest:$(br2)$(#FFAA00)Bronze$() — Basic stats, easy to get$(br2)$(#AAAAAA)Silver$() — Medium, includes four elements$(br2)$(#FFAA00)Gold$() — Advanced, includes combined elements$(br2)$(#5555FF)Prime$() — Enhanced, Lich drops only$(br2)$(#AAAAAA)Galvanized$() — Prime tier, with kill stacks$(br2)$(#FF5555)Executioner$() — Warframe only, with kill stacks$(br2)$(#AA00AA)Riven$() — Rarest, fully random stats
Riven mods may have negative stats.$(br)Negatives make positives stronger.$(br2)Galvanized and Executioner series$(br)provide kill stack effects —$(br)the more you kill, the stronger/tankier you get.
$(l)Upgrade Path$()$(br2)Early: Bronze and Silver are enough$(br2)Mid: Switch to Gold mods$(br2)Late: Prime + Galvanized + Executioner$(br)        Cycle Rivens for good rolls
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.riven_module.p1: Fully random stats, the rarest mods.$(br2)Multiple positive stats, possibly with negatives.$(br)Negatives make positives stronger.$(br2)$(l)Disposition$()$(br2)Rivens have different disposition tiers.$(br)Higher disposition = stronger stats.$(br2)Weapon Rivens come in 3 types:$(br)Melee, Ranged, Universal
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.riven_module.p2: $(l)Cycling$()$(br2)At the Requiem Forge:$(br)Riven Mod + Kuva → Re-roll all stats$(br2)Cost increases with each cycle.$(br)Cannot roll combined elements.$(br)Disposition tier stays the same.$(br2)Stop when you get stats you like.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kill_stack.p1: $(l)Galvanized$() and $(l)Executioner$() series mods$(br)provide kill stack effects.$(br2)Gain temporary stat boosts on kill.$(br)Consecutive kills refresh duration.$(br)Stacks decay when you stop killing.$(br2)Each stat has independent max stacks.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kill_stack.p2: $(l)Weapon Stacks$() (faster decay)$(br2)Base damage, multishot, crit damage,$(br)status chance, attack range, speed,$(br)burst radius, fire rate$(br2)$(l)Warframe Stacks$() (slower decay)$(br2)Health, shield, armor, sprint speed,$(br)shield recovery, various resistances,$(br)regen multiplier, loot multiplier, mining speed
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.warframe_module: Install at the $(thing)Warframe Arsenal$().$(br)Active at all times, no weapon needed.$(br)Up to 8, bound to character, kept on death.$(br2)$(l)Stat Types$()$(br2)· Health, armor, shield capacity$(br)· Sprint speed, knockback resistance$(br)· Fire/electric/homologous resistance$(br)· Reach distance, mining speed$(br)· Regen multiplier, loot multiplier$(br)· Jump height, fall resistance

$(l)Shield System$()$(br2)Equipping shield capacity mods$(br)grants an absorb shield (golden hearts).$(br2)After taking damage, enters cooldown.$(br)Shield slowly recovers after cooldown.$(br2)Full shield break = longer cooldown.

Craft the Warframe Arsenal early!$(br2)The always-active bonuses from$(br)Warframe mods are more important than you think.$(br2)$(thing)Vitality$() and $(thing)Steel Fiber$()$(br)are essential for nearly every build.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.tacz_overview.p: Kuva Lich fully supports TACZ guns.$(br)Gild a gun to start installing mods.$(br2)All universal weapon attributes$(br)(damage, crit, status, elements, etc.)$(br)work on guns too.$(br2)Plus a set of gun-exclusive attributes.

$(l)Gun-Exclusive Attributes$()$(br2)$(l)Damage:$()$(br)Gun damage, headshot damage,$(br)multishot, first bullet damage$(br2)$(l)Handling:$()$(br)Fire rate, reload speed,$(br)recoil reduction, aim speed, accuracy$(br2)$(l)Ammo:$()$(br)Magazine capacity, projectile speed

$(l)Gun Multishot$()$(br2)Gun multishot scales proportionally$(br)with original pellet count.$(br2)Single-shot → chance for extra bullet$(br)Shotgun → pellets scale proportionally$(br2)Extra pellet damage is split by original count,$(br)preventing total damage from ballooning.$(br2)Each bullet independently$(br)rolls for element procs on hit.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.tacz_gun_attrib: $(l)Gun Damage$() — Independent multiplier$(br2)$(l)Headshot Multiplier$() — Extra damage on headshots$(br2)$(l)First Bullet Damage$() — Bonus on full mag first shot$(br)(Does not appear in Rivens)$(br2)$(l)Fire Rate$() — Reduces shot interval$(br2)$(l)Reload Speed$() — Faster reload and bolt$(br)Reload animation speed syncs

$(l)Magazine Capacity$() — More ammo$(br2)$(l)Projectile Speed$() — Bullets fly faster and farther$(br2)$(l)Recoil Reduction$() — Less pitch and yaw kick$(br2)$(l)Aim Speed$() — Faster scope-in$(br2)$(l)Accuracy$() — Tighter bullet spread

$(l)Build Ideas$()$(br2)$(l)Rifle:$() Gun damage + magazine + recoil$(br2)$(l)Shotgun:$() Multishot + reload speed$(br2)$(l)Sniper:$() Headshot + first bullet + projectile speed$(br2)$(l)SMG:$() Fire rate + status chance + elements
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_master.p1: The Kuva Lich has three dynamic resistances:$(br2)$(l)Adaptive Resistance$()$(br)Using the same attack type repeatedly$(br)gradually increases damage reduction.$(br)Switching between melee/bow/magic resets it.$(br2)$(l)Combo Diminishing$()$(br)Too many hits in a short time reduces damage.$(br)Pace yourself, don't mindlessly spam.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_master.p2: $(l)Single Hit Damage Cap$()$(br2)Single hits have a soft cap — one-shots are impossible.$(br)Steady sustained damage is most efficient.$(br2)$(l)Other Traits$()$(br2)· Auto-regeneration$(br)· Immune to fall damage$(br)· AoE attacks$(br)· Strong knockback$(br)· Heals on successful hits
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_master.p3: $(l)Kill Strategy$()$(br2)· Alternate melee, bow, and magic$(br)  to avoid adaptive resistance.$(br2)· Bows deal bonus damage to Kuva entities.$(br)  Other projectiles and magic are less effective.$(br2)· Keep fighting — use the damage growth.$(br2)· Fight in flat, open areas.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_master.p4: $(l)Decryption Success Rewards$()$(br2)· Kuva weapon$(br)· High-tier mods$(br)· Lots of Kuva and Riven Slivers$(br)· Requiem Ultimatum (chance)$(br)· Lich Reliquary$(br)· All confiscated items returned$(br)· Weapon level caps increased
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_slave.p1: The main source of decryption progress.$(br)Much more common than Liches.$(br2)· Has flat damage reduction, tougher than normal mobs$(br)· Attacks cause strong knockback$(br)· Heals slightly on each hit$(br2)· Bows deal extra damage$(br)· Projectiles and magic are less effective$(br)· Immune to fall damage
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.kuva_slave.p2: $(l)Kill Rewards$()$(br2)· Decryption progress (most important)$(br)· Kuva (chance)$(br)· Riven Slivers (chance)$(br)· Requiem Gems (chance, Fortune improves rate)$(br)· Various tier mods (chance)$(br2)After unlocking answers, watch out$(br)for the confiscation mechanic when picking up items!
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.requiem_ore.p1: Generates deep underground.$(br)Requires a diamond pickaxe.$(br2)Drops: Requiem Cards, various mods, experience.$(br2)Fortune actually reduces Requiem Card drop rate!$(br)Use a $(thing)Requiem Destroyed$() enchanted pick instead.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.requiem_ore.p2: $(l)Requiem Destroyed Enchantment$()$(br2)· Greatly increases Requiem Card drop rate$(br)· Doubles experience gained$(br)· Faster mining of Requiem blocks$(br2)Prepare two pickaxes:$(br)Requiem Destroyed for Requiem Ore, Fortune for everything else.
Widely generated underground.$(br)Only needs a stone pickaxe.$(br)Drops only experience orbs, no items.$(br)Much more common than Requiem Ore.$(br2)Use an $(thing)Experience Collector$() enchanted pick$(br)for even more experience.
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.weapon_table.p1: Install weapon mods on gilded weapons.$(br2)Bottom slot for weapon, top slots for mods.$(br)No duplicate types, max 1 Riven.
Install warframe mods, always active.$(br)No weapon needed — just place mods directly.$(br2)Mods are bound to character, kept on death.$(br2)Craft this early!
kuvalich.guidebook.entry.item_attr_damag: $(l)Base Damage$()$(br2)· Melee Damage meleeDamage$(br)· Ranged Damage remoteDamage$(br)· Arrow Damage arrowDamage$(br)· Projectile Damage projectileDamage$(br)· Magic Damage magicDamage

$(l)Conditional Damage$()$(br2)· Non-crit Damage$(br)  baseDamageWhenNotCriticalStrike$(br2)$(l)Bane Damage$()$(br2)· vs Unknown bane_of_undefined$(br)· vs Undead bane_of_undead$(br)· vs Arthropods bane_of_arthropod$(br)· vs Illagers bane_of_illager

$(l)Dash Specialization$()$(br2)· Dash Crit Chance$(br)  dashMeleeCriticalStrikeProbability$(br2)· Dash Attack Range$(br)  dashAttackRange$(br2)· Dash Status Chance$(br)  dashTriggerChance$(br2)Only active during dash attacks.
